content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Manager (Security) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Contract, initially three (03) years, extendable/renewable annually subject to satisfactory performance and need of the Institute

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists two essential requirements for the Manager (Security) post. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. An Ex-Servicemen, retired/voluntarily retired, not below the rank of Major or equivalent in defence forces/paramilitary forces. Post Graduate/MBA from a recognized Institute/University in regular mode with minimum 60% marks, with 5 years of relevant work experience, out of which 2 years should be in a managerial capacity. Desirable: candidates having an NCC certificate (B or C) and a Fire Safety Management course will be preferred. No rounding off of percentage is allowed. Candidates must fill in their exact percentage of marks in the form. The upper age limit is 40 years. The crucial date for determining the age limit is the closing date for receipt of applications. The age limit is relaxable for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories as per Central Government rules, for which applicants must attach the necessary certificate(s) as prescribed by the Government of India. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the closing date for receipt of online applications, failing which the application will be summarily rejected. The Institute encourages applications from women candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly consolidated emoluments are ₹ 92,000, with fixed HRA of ₹ 10,620, a total of ₹ 1,02,620. The selected candidate is engaged on contract basis initially for three (03) years, extendable/renewable annually subject to satisfactory performance and need of the Institute. The position is purely on contract basis, so there is no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute. The panel of recommended candidates is valid for one year from the date of approval of the Competent Authority. The Institute can make appointments in the future also by operating the panel within that period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may submit their application on or before 07.12.2026 through the Google Form link given in the notice. No other mode for receipt of applications will be entertained. Open the Google Form link given in the notice (see Important Links). Give a valid and active email ID, since all communication about the selection process is made only through email. Fill in the exact percentage of marks, without rounding off. Candidates claiming age relaxation (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) must attach the necessary certificate(s) as prescribed by the Government of India. Submit the form finally before the last date. After final submission, no request for modification or correction is entertained. The Institute is not responsible for incomplete submissions or technical issues at the candidate's end. Incomplete or incorrect applications are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection may be made through a Written Test, Skill Test and/or Personal Interview, as decided by the Competent Authority. The mode of selection may be offline or online, as decided by the Institute. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of shortlisted candidates to a reasonable number based on higher qualifications and/or experience or any other criteria. The date(s) of the selection process will be communicated later to shortlisted candidates only, through email. Shortlisted candidates must produce all original certificates, degrees and other documents on educational/professional qualifications, work experience, age and caste for verification at the time of the final selection process. Failure to do so may result in cancellation of candidature. No TA/DA or any other incidental expenses will be reimbursed to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Manager (Security) vacancies are there at IIM Lucknow?
faq.answer: There is 01 position of Manager (Security) under Advt. No. IIML/Rectt.-10C/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: The last date is 07.12.2026. Applications must be submitted through the Google Form on or before that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: The candidate must be an Ex-Serviceman, retired or voluntarily retired, not below the rank of Major or equivalent. A Post Graduate/MBA in regular mode with minimum 60% marks is needed, along with 5 years of relevant experience, of which 2 years in a managerial capacity.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIM Lucknow Manager (Security) post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years, counted as on the closing date for receipt of applications. SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates get relaxation as per Central Government rules and must attach the prescribed certificate(s).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated emoluments are ₹ 92,000 plus fixed HRA of ₹ 10,620, a total of ₹ 1,02,620.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: Submit the Google Form given in the notice on or before 07.12.2026. No other mode of application is entertained, and no corrections are allowed after final submission.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: The selection may be made through a Written Test, Skill Test and/or Personal Interview, as decided by the Competent Authority. Shortlisted candidates are informed of the dates only through email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIM Lucknow Manager (Security) job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely on contract basis, initially for three years, extendable or renewable annually subject to satisfactory performance and the Institute's need. Candidates have no right to claim regularization or absorption.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹ 92,000 for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.answer: The notice gives the monthly consolidated emoluments as ₹ 92,000 plus a fixed HRA of ₹ 10,620, making a total of ₹ 1,02,620.

faq.question: Q10. Will IIM Lucknow pay travel expenses to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA or any other incidental expenses will be reimbursed to attend the interview.
